product_one_liner.value: Sona provides an AI-powered workforce-management platform—including forecasting, scheduling, HR and payroll tools—for large frontline organisations.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage describes workforce decisions across locations; page scrape lists AI workforce management capabilities.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page exists and directs businesses to request a custom quote; no listed prices required.

named_customers.notes: Both are named as Sona customers on the company About page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 51–200 employees; the required range bands split that span, so this source does not establish whether Sona fits 51–100 or 101–200. Use unknown would be more appropriate, but this field requires one allowed band; reported range overlaps both.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies London as headquarters; company identity and funding coverage identify it as UK-based.

founded_year.notes: Company About page states it was founded in 2021.

eng_blog.notes: Visible blog index is primarily workforce-management, HR, operational and product/marketing content; no evidence of at least two engineering-authored technical build posts.

public_docs.notes: Homepage navigation/footer includes product, customer stories, blog, resources, trust and company links, but no public product documentation or help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current job listings include Labour AI Specialist; AI-sales role exclusion does not apply to this specialist role.

model_provider.notes: No public statement naming the product's AI model or provider was found in the accessible company pages.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust Centre is linked, but its certification claims could not be retrieved from the available evidence.

last_funding.notes: Company's April 1, 2026 announcement reports a $45 million Series B.

raised_18mo.notes: The April 2026 Series B falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current listing includes a Business Development Representative role.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest dateable item surfaced in the company blog search is a customer announcement from Dec. 11, 2025, predating the six-month window; no qualifying product/major feature launch in the window was found.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No verifiable dated C-level/VP join or departure announcement, nor a sufficiently checkable team roster, was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No company-specific job post, docs page or integration page naming a sales/marketing system was verified.
